# Level 1: First steps {#sec-level-1}

::: {.callout-note title="Level 1 at a glance" appearance="simple"}
**Builds on:** Core game · **New components:** None · **Playing time:** about 30 minutes
:::

## What's new {#sec-level-1-new}

Level 1 is the core game with no additions. It's the best way to learn superposition, entanglement and measurement.

## Additional components {#sec-level-1-components}

None. Level 1 uses only the core components (@sec-components).

## Setup changes {#sec-level-1-setup}

None. Follow the core setup (@sec-setup).

## New rules {#sec-level-1-rules}

None. Play with the core rules (@sec-turn and @sec-quantum).



## Cards {#sec-level-1-cards}

### Superposition

Note: Superposition is for lanes only in level 1.

Card description: If your counters are in the same lane, move one counter to the other lane with the same number.

Number in deck: 10 cards

### Measurement

Note: The counters must be in a superposition, i.e. in two different lanes to start with. You roll the die to determine which counter to move where.

Card description: If your counters are in two lanes, roll the die. If you roll:
- 1-3 move the outer counter to the inner counter
- 4-6 move the inner counter to the outer counter

Number in deck: 10 cards

### +/- 1/2/3 (outer/inner lane)

Note: there are two different types of cards for outer and inner lane.
One card for each number (n=1,2,3).

Card description: Move all of your outer/inner lane counters forward/backward by 1/2/3 spaces.
If you have no counters in the outer/inner lane, nothing happens.




### Move forward (inner lane)
